incident-bot: INCIDENT 3332100000 — routing anomalies detected: elevated error rate + model-mismatch. Smart-router fallbacks picking unexpected variants. Paging oncall.

Maya (oncall): Paging Jeff. Jeff you oncall? :hand:

Jeff (sre): I'm oncall, getting pages. What are we seeing?

Maya (oncall): Symptoms: customers seeing hallucinations and latency spikes. Logs show a bunch of requests that should have used 'gpu-quant-v2' falling back to 'cpu-small-legacy' (much smaller model). Spike started ~09:12 UTC. Router debug shows fallback resolved via a deprecated field present in the live config.

Oliver (runtime): I pulled the live routing config. During last night's schema migration we renamed a few fields and deprecated 'preferred_variant'. The migration left the old field as null which our runtime treated as "explicitly unset" and triggered the old default fallback. Live snippet from config dump: 
```json
{
  "routing_policy": {
    "region_priority": ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"],
    "preferred_variant": null,
    "fallback_variant": "legacy-small"
  }
}
```
The new schema expects: 
```json
{
  "routing_policy": {
    "region_priority": ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"],
    "fallback": {"variant": "stable-v2"}
  }
}
```
Because preferred_variant is present (null) the validator didn't inject the new fallback.variant default and the runtime ended up using the old code path that had 'legacy-small' as default.

Sam (support): Impact numbers from Support: approx 1.2k req/min impacted at peak, sustained ~35 minutes. ~7 customers reported degraded output quality (autocomplete hallucinations), ~23 customers saw elevated error/latency spikes. No billing or data-loss reports yet.

Jeff (sre): Ok. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) push temporary per-route override to pin fallback_variant -> "stable-v2" 2) revert the schema migration flag to stop automated rollout 3) add a runtime guard to prefer explicit new-format fallback when present 4) notify customers.

Carla (platform): I can push the override via the admin API console. Will wait for ACK from SRE before applying to prod.

Jeff (sre): ACK. Maya, kick off the rollback PR. Oliver, please prepare a quick validator patch that rejects null on deprecated fields or maps them to explicit new defaults.

Oliver (runtime): Preparing patch. Temporary patch I'll run now (curl to admin API):
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://console.redwood.internal/api/configs/routing" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{
  "overrides": [{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback_variant":"stable-v2"}]
}'
```

Maya (oncall): Applying override. Will monitor metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by Carla — routing-override-3332100000
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded (60s). override active.

Sam (support): Metrics check: error rate dropped from 8.2% -> 1.1% within 5m of override. Latency back to normal. First customer confirmations coming in that hallucinations reduced.

Jeff (sre): Good mitigation. Root cause summary: schema migration left deprecated field in a null state; runtime fallback logic treated that as not migrated and fell back to legacy default variant. We need: validation, migration tests, and a safer defaulting strategy.

Maya (oncall): Customer impact summary for postmortem: transient incorrect model variant selection for ~35 minutes; estimated ~42k requests affected; 7 customers experienced degraded output quality; no secrets or data exfiltration. Support will send status update.

Sam (support): Support update sent to affected customers (template: timeline, mitigation, next steps).

Oliver (runtime): Follow-ups I will own: 1) validator patch to reject null deprecated fields 2) migration test harness to run against a copy of live configs 3) change runtime to prefer new-schema explicit values over legacy defaults.

Carla (platform): Platform follow-ups: add canary for schema rollouts (small fraction of configs), add a preflight that detects ambiguous nulls and flags them.

Jeff (sre): Severity set to P2. I'll stay on watch for 30m. Assign postmortem: Maya (write draft), Oliver (technical appendix), Carla (deployment timeline).

Maya (oncall): Noting action items. Anyone else?

Jeff (sre): I'll clear pager in 30m if metrics stay stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT 3332100000 — mitigated, status: monitoring. Pager cleared.

Maya (oncall): Closing thread for now, will attach logs and config diffs to the postmortem doc.
